title: Qiagen QIAmp PowerFecal Pro Extraction Protocol
author: Michael Dan Siemon
materials: Qiagen QIAmp PowerFecal Pro extraction kit

steps.title: Prepare wastewater pellet
steps.instruction: Concentrate the wastewater sample to obtain a pellet.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly mix wastewater sample.
Aliquot 40 mL into a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 4500 x g for 120 min.
Decant supernatant (assume 280 µl pellet).

steps.title: Perform bead-beating lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse the pellet using Solution CD1 and bead-beating.

substeps.instruction: Add 650 μl of Solution CD1 to the wastewater pellet.
Transfer solution to the PowerBead Pro Tube.
Perform bead-beating 4x for 30s at 4 m/s (as a substitute for vortexing).
Centrifuge the PowerBead Pro Tube at 15,000 x g for 1 min.

steps.title: Perform secondary lysis
steps.instruction: Treat the lysate with Solution CD2 to remove inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 ml Microcentrifuge Tube.
Add 200 μl of Solution CD2 and vortex for 5 s.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 min.

steps.title: Prepare for RNA binding
steps.instruction: Prepare the supernatant for column loading using Solution EA.

substeps.instruction: Avoiding the pellet, transfer up to 650 μl of supernatant to a clean 2 ml Microcentrifuge Tube.
Add 650 μl of Solution EA and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Bind RNA to spin column
steps.instruction: Load the sample onto the MB RNA Spin Column.

substeps.instruction: Load 650 μl supernatant-EA mix into an MB RNA Spin Column.
Centrifuge at 15,000x g for 1 min.
Discard the flow-through and repeat until all solution has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash the spin column
steps.instruction: Wash the column with Solution EA.

substeps.instruction: Add 650 μl Solution EA to the Spin Column.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 min.

steps.title: Perform DNase digestion
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the bound RNA.

substeps.instruction: Mix 45 μl DNase Digestion Solution and 5 μl DNase I stock enzyme.
Place the MB RNA Spin Column into a clean 2 ml Collection Tube.
Add the DNase Digestion Solution to the center of the filter.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Wash after DNase digestion
steps.instruction: Wash the column to remove digestion reagents.

substeps.instruction: Add 650 μl Solution EA to the Spin Column.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 min.

steps.title: Final wash and drying
steps.instruction: Perform final wash and dry the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Discard the flow-through.
Add 500 μl Solution C5.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 min.
Replace the collection tube and dry the Spin Column by centrifuging at 20,000 x g for 1 min.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Recover the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Place the spin column in a 1.5 ml collection tube.
Add 100 μl of RNase-free water.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 min.

steps.title: Post-extraction tube treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the PowerBead Pro Tube with phenol-chloroform-isoamyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Spin the PowerBead Pro Tube briefly to ensure beads have settled at the bottom.
Add 100 μl of phenol−chloroform−isoamyl alcohol to the PowerBead Pro Tube.
